limitations.note: Replacing the falling-edge counter comparison with a delayed copy of `clkp` restored the 50% duty cycle but shifted both output edges half an input cycle later than the one-line threshold fix.
The test checked that transitions landed on some input edge, but never checked which edge they should land on after reset, so it passed despite the phase shift.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire test invocation before simulation could run.
